newsitem.title: USA: Bandag Q4 net down as operating costs rise.
newsitem.headline: Bandag Q4 net down as operating costs rise.

text.p: Bandag Inc said Wednesday a significant increase in operating costs affected earnings in the fourth quarter ended December 31.
Bandag posted net income of $21.7 milllion in the quarter, compared with $25.5 million one year ago.

The company said the expense of replacing lost distribution in North America and South Africa, along with higher spending for training, product development and sales and marketing programs, increased costs in the period.
Bandag makes rubber for its tire retreading franchisees.
The company's shares were off 1/8 Wednesday at 46-3/4.
